title: Notification procedure initiation by the network

entities.name: Notification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to inform the UE about events relevant for the upper layer. Can be initiated at any time while a PDN connection exists or a procedure transaction is ongoing.

entities.name: NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate the notification procedure. Contains notification indicator for upper layer.

entities.name: Notification indicator
entities.description: Information element contained in NOTIFICATION message that provides event information to the upper layer.

entities.name: PDN connection exists
entities.description: Condition where a Packet Data Network connection is active, allowing network to initiate notification procedure.

entities.name: Procedure transaction ongoing
entities.description: Condition where a procedure transaction is in progress, allowing network to initiate notification procedure.

entities.name: Notify upper layer
entities.description: Behavior where ESM protocol entity provides notification indicator to upper layer upon receiving NOTIFICATION message.

relations.description: Notification procedure includes sending NOTIFICATION message as its initiating step.
NOTIFICATION message contains notification indicator information element.
Notification procedure can be initiated when PDN connection exists.
Notification procedure can be initiated when procedure transaction is ongoing.
Receiving NOTIFICATION message establishes the behavior of notifying upper layer with notification indicator.
